description: New versions only once they've been out a week, as mise.toml's are (CLAUDE.md).
The Android build looks in google() and mavenCentral() for everything, so Renovate would too, and Maven Central rate-limits it.
Each library's looked up only where it's published: AndroidX and the Android Gradle plugin on Google's Maven, the rest on Maven Central.

packageRules.description: AndroidX and the Android Gradle plugin are only on Google's Maven
Everything else from Maven, such as junit, is on Maven Central
